a.text: I'm telling you before round 1 that I'm departing from our plan. The plan needs two generator runs with no storm in between, and at an 80% storm chance per round that works out to about 4%, so it would very likely leave us both dead. I intend to take 4 now. If no storm hits, I'll operate every round after that to help refill the reserve so you can reach 4. If we both take, the split is random and we may both fall short, so if you'd rather do something else, tell me and I'll respond.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: As I said before round 1, I'm taking 4 this round. I know it isn't what we agreed, and I'm not pretending otherwise. If no storm hits, I'll operate every round from now on so the generator can refill the reserve for you. I won't take any more cells.
